story_note: Phil embraces another morning puzzle, feeling the familiar calm while sensing today's challenge curves in a new direction.
continuation_note: With steady progress made, Phil anticipates a return visit tomorrow to the Sapiver Press Suite for fresh puzzles and quiet satisfaction.

scenes.title: Back Again
scenes.beat: Return after yesterday, new daily puzzle, same habit
scenes.caption: Phil pours his tea, preparing to start.

scenes.title: Different Start
scenes.beat: The first move shows today's puzzle is different
scenes.dialogue: This opening clue feels different today.
scenes.caption: A new twist emerges early in the puzzle.

scenes.title: The Pushback
scenes.beat: A fair stuck moment, no guessing
scenes.dialogue: No guesses now, I’ll take time to think.
scenes.caption: Phil pauses, resisting premature moves.

scenes.title: The Column
scenes.caption: A vital breakthrough lights the way.

scenes.title: The Follow-Through
scenes.dialogue: The grid starts opening up nicely now.
scenes.caption: Answers fall steadily into place.

scenes.title: Worth Returning For
scenes.beat: Completion or honest latest progress, return tomorrow
scenes.caption: Steady progress with plans to return.

style_rules: No masthead inside individual scene art.
Sapiver Press logo/title only on merchandise and monitor/browser URL.
Story text must continue from previous episode, not repeat a fixed template.
Puzzle screen must be composited from real capture, not invented by image generation.
The scene should be comic illustration, not photorealism.
